# Lantana Consulting Group EventCatalog Documentation

> This internal platform provides a comprehensive view of our event-driven architecture across all systems. Use this portal to discover existing domains, explore services and their dependencies, and understand the message contracts that connect our infrastructure

## Events
- [Auditable Event Occurred - AuditableEventOccurred - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/events/AuditableEventOccurred/0.6.0.mdx) - Captures an auditable action for security or compliance tracking.- [Measure Evaluated - MeasureEvaluated - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/events/MeasureEvaluated/0.6.0.mdx) - Marks completion of all evaluations for a patient.- [Measure Report Generated - MeasureReportGenerated - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/events/MeasureReportGenerated/0.6.0.mdx) - Signals that a MeasureReport has been generated for a patient.- [Patient Census Scheduled - PatientCensusScheduled - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/events/PatientCensusScheduled/0.6.0.mdx) - Schedules retrieval of the current inpatient list.- [Patient Event - PatientEvent - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/events/PatientEvent/0.6.0.mdx) - Indicates that a patient admission or discharge has occurred.- [Patient Lists Acquired - PatientListsAcquired - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/events/PatientListsAcquired/0.6.0.mdx) - Provides a list of patient identifiers retrieved from a facility.- [Payload Submitted - PayloadSubmitted - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/events/PayloadSubmitted/0.6.0.mdx) - Confirms that a payload has been created and stored.- [Ready for Validation - ReadyForValidation - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/events/ReadyForValidation/0.6.0.mdx) - Notifies that a patient’s submission bundle is ready to be validated.- [Ready to Acquire - ReadyToAcquire - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/events/ReadyToAcquire/0.6.0.mdx) - Indicates when a data acquisition log is ready to be processed- [Report Scheduled - ReportScheduled - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/events/ReportScheduled/0.6.0.mdx) - Announces that a reporting period has started for a tenant.- [Report Status Updated - ReportStatusUpdated - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/events/ReportStatusUpdated/0.6.0.mdx) - Emitted by various services to report the success or failure of specific reporting stages for a patient or a report.- [Resource Acquired - ResourceAcquired - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/events/ResourceAcquired/0.6.0.mdx) - Represents a single FHIR resource retrieved from a facility.- [Resource Evaluated - ResourceEvaluated - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/events/ResourceEvaluated/0.6.0.mdx) - Contains a FHIR resource that has been evaluated for measures.- [Resource Normalized - ResourceNormalized - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/events/ResourceNormalized/0.6.0.mdx) - Indicates that a FHIR resource has been standardized.- [Resource Normalized - ResourceNormalized - 0.7.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/events/ResourceNormalized/0.7.0.mdx) - Indicates that a FHIR resource has been standardized.- [Validation Complete - ValidationComplete - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/events/ValidationComplete/0.6.0.mdx) - Conveys the result of validating a patient’s submission bundle.

## Commands
- [Data Acquisition Requested - DataAcquisitionRequested - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/commands/DataAcquisitionRequested/0.6.0.mdx) - Signals that FHIR resources should be fetched for a patient.- [Evaluation Requested - EvaluationRequested - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/commands/EvaluationRequested/0.6.0.mdx) - Indicates that patient data is ready to be evaluated.- [Generate Report Requested - GenerateReportRequested - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/commands/GenerateReportRequested/0.6.0.mdx) - Requests that a report be generated or regenerated outside the normal schedule.- [Submit Report - SubmitReport - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/commands/SubmitReport/0.6.0.mdx) - Instructs that a completed report be packaged for submission.- [Submit Report - SubmitReport - 0.7.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/commands/SubmitReport/0.7.0.mdx) - Instructs that a completed report be packaged for submission.- [Validate CodeSystem Code - ValidateCodeSystemCode - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/commands/ValidateCodeSystemCode/0.6.0.mdx) - Validate a code against a code system.- [Validate ValueSet Code - ValidateValueSetCode - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/commands/ValidateValueSetCode/0.6.0.mdx) - Validate a code against a value set.

## Queries
- [Get Facilities List - GetFacilitiesList - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/queries/GetFacilitiesList/0.6.0.mdx) - Queries the Tenant service for a list of all configured facilities.- [Get Facility Configuration - GetFacilityConfig - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/queries/GetFacilityConfig/0.6.0.mdx) - Queries the Tenant service to retrieve configuration for a specific facility.- [Get Service Info - GetServiceInfo - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/queries/GetServiceInfo/0.6.0.mdx) - A common health/info endpoint available on services.

## Services
- [Account Service - AccountService - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/services/AccountService/0.6.0.mdx) - Service that contains Account related information and functionality
- [Admin Backend-for-Frontend - AdminBFF - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/services/AdminBFF/0.6.0.mdx) - The administrative backend service that provides functionality for the front-end- [Admin UI (front-end) - AdminUI - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/services/AdminUI/0.6.0.mdx) - The administrative front-end UI service- [Audit Service - AuditService - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/services/AuditService/0.6.0.mdx) - Service that contains Audit related information and functionality
- [Census Service - CensusService - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/services/CensusService/0.6.0.mdx) - Service that contains Census related information and functionality
- [Data Acquisition Service - DataAcquisitionService - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/services/DataAcquisitionService/0.6.0.mdx) - Service that acquires data based on reporting requirements- [Data Acquisition Worker Service - DataAcquisitionWorkerService - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/services/DataAcquisitionWorkerService/0.6.0.mdx) - The Data Acquisition Worker is a .NET background service that listens on the ReadyToAcquire Kafka topic and processes queued data acquisition logs to fetch FHIR resources for a facility.- [Measure Evaluation Service - MeasureEvalService - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/services/MeasureEvalService/0.6.0.mdx) - [Measure Evaluation Service - MeasureEvalService - 0.7.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/services/MeasureEvalService/0.7.0.mdx) - Service that evaluates data against FHIR measure definitions (aka: CQL)
- [Normalization Service - NormalizationService - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/services/NormalizationService/0.6.0.mdx) - Service that performs normalization operations according to a tenant's configuration on data for the tenant.- [Query Dispatch Service - QueryDispatchService - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/services/QueryDispatchService/0.6.0.mdx) - The Query Dispatch service is a .NET Core microservice that controls how long Link Cloud waits after a patient’s 
discharge before requesting FHIR resources from a facility.
- [Report Service - ReportService - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/services/ReportService/0.6.0.mdx) - Service that contains Report related information and functionality
- [Report Service - ReportService - 0.7.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/services/ReportService/0.7.0.mdx) - Service that contains Report related information and functionality
- [Submission Service - SubmissionService - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/services/SubmissionService/0.6.0.mdx) - Service that provides functionality for submitting report data
- [Tenant Service - TenantService - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/services/TenantService/0.6.0.mdx) - Service that provides functionality for the management of Tenants in the system
- [Terminology Service - TerminologyService - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/services/TerminologyService/0.6.0.mdx) - A service that exposes a limited FHIR Terminology interface (CodeSystem, ValueSet) to support code validation and ValueSet expansion for Link Cloud based on artifacts loaded from the local file system.- [Validation Service - ValidationService - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/services/ValidationService/0.6.0.mdx) - Service that provides functionality for validating clinical data in the system.


## Domains
- [Compliance - Compliance - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/domains/Compliance/0.6.0.mdx) - Compliance Domain- [Data Access - DataAccess - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/domains/DataAccess/0.6.0.mdx) - Data Access Domain- [Knowledge Artifact Management - KnowledgeArtifactManagement - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/domains/KnowledgeArtifactManagement/0.6.0.mdx) - Domain that contains knowledge artifacts that support the function of Link including FHIR IGs, Profiles, dQMs, and Terminology.- [Report - Report - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/domains/Report/0.6.0.mdx) - Report related information and function- [Tenant - Tenant - 0.6.0 ](https://lantanagroup.github.io/docs/domains/Tenant/0.6.0.mdx) - Tenant related information and function
